scientific.integrity: All minimizer regimes follow from an exact piecewise expectation formula and an exact cubic sign comparison. Numerical root evaluation is descriptive rather than evidentiary.
scientific.limitations: The theorem classifies only two-coordinate unit coefficient vectors for the equal-probability two-radius symmetric perturbation and the first absolute moment; it does not claim the arbitrary-dimensional optimizer.

title: Exact two-coordinate Khinchin phase transition for a two-radius Rademacher perturbation
